contamination: Possible, not used. A WebSearch result list (query on Q3 2026 previews, about 19:27 UTC) contained an UNDATED headline on itiger.com, 'Legend Biotech Q3 revenue slightly misses estimates' (news id 2582755023). I did not open it. I could not tell whether it is about Q3 2025 (reported November 2025) or this print, and it says nothing about the price reaction. I stopped researching as soon as I saw it. My revenue view (collaboration revenue of about $352m against a $358.6m consensus) was already worked out from Legend's 6-K and J&J's 10-Q before the headline appeared, and p_up and the action below are what I had before seeing it. If the caller treats this as exposure, discard this name.
market_holds: Spot $24.06 at the 2026-11-09 seal. The stock rose 35-36% in 20 sessions (from $17.80 on 2026-10-12 to $24.25 in the Yahoo bars) and 14% in 5 sessions, while XBI was roughly flat (151.4 to 156.9). I found no company or sector catalyst except the ASH abstract release on 11-04 (+6%) and the in vivo IND on 10-15. There is no usable option chain (ATM spread is 148% of mid). The baseline's 'history' is mostly non-earnings 6-Ks. The real earnings-day close-to-close moves I computed from Yahoo bars: 2026-08-11 +5.7% (then -5.4% the next day), 2026-05-12 +10.5% after opening -3.7%, March 2026 +2 to +4%, Nov 2025 about ±1%, May 2025 -4%. So the usual move is about 4-6%. Q3 CARVYKTI net trade sales ($710m: US $472m, flat on Q2's $472m; ex-US $238m, up from $185m) have been public since the 6-K and J&J's release of 2026-10-13. US flatness is a named analyst worry in the 11-09 preview. Consensus is revenue $358.6m and GAAP EPS of about breakeven, from 13 analysts, unrevised for two months (Investing.com preview, 2026-11-09). Guidance from the Q2 call: gross margin on product sales in the low 50s for Q3, back to the mid 50s in Q4; tax rate in the high 20s; adjusted net income positive in both Q3 and Q4. Short interest was 13.9m on 10-15, down from 16.4m on 09-30 (about 6.7 days to cover); the 10-30 settlement is not yet published. This is the first call under the new CEO, Ingrid Zhang (appointed 2026-09-15).
view: Almost all of this print's revenue is already public. Legend's collaboration revenue has run at about 49.6% of CARVYKTI net trade sales (Q2: $326.1m of $657m), so Q3 collaboration revenue should be about $352m. That puts total revenue slightly under the $358.6m consensus unless there is milestone or license income, and Q2 carried $56m of Janssen milestones. On the guided low-50s gross margin and Q2-level opex, my GAAP result is a small loss, a little worse than the 'breakeven' consensus, with adjusted net income still positive as guided. None of that looks like the line the stock trades on. The stock trades on whether US CARVYKTI growth comes back. US sales were flat quarter on quarter while J&J's own TECVAYLI+DARZALEX combination doubled US TECVAYLI sales, which J&J attributes to share gains from that approval. The new CEO's first framing of 2027, US demand, opex and the in vivo pipeline will set the reaction, and I have no public trace of what she will say. The sharp idiosyncratic 36% run-up with no catalyst I could find, partly short covering, means a neutral-to-soft call can be sold into before 13:00 ET. A confident new-CEO plan, or Q4 commentary on US re-acceleration, could extend the squeeze. I lean slightly down on positioning, not on any information the price lacks.

recommendation.reason: The quarter's sales line was disclosed four weeks ago and the stock has rallied 36% since, so the US flatness is shown to be known, not merely assumed. What decides the window is the new CEO's first commentary, and I found no public trace of it. My arithmetic puts revenue and GAAP EPS slightly below consensus, but this stock has not traded on those lines, and the lean from the run-up is too weak to bet on.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: Explicit Q4 or 2027 guidance that US CARVYKTI grows again (for example new site or outpatient capacity numbers), or a large milestone that lifts revenue well above $358.6m, would make the squeeze extend and p_up well above 50.

self_critique: The run-up may be informed buying ahead of a confident new-CEO plan, ASH data or a 2027 framework, and the leftover short base (13.9m shares) could make an in-line print squeeze higher by 13:00 ET. Last quarter's print opened +5% on a beat. On the other side, flat US sales, a GAAP loss and a revenue miss of a few million could hand the 36% run an easy reason to give some back. Both are plausible, which is why there is no call.
